How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
Orders currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. For the contiguous U.S., estimated transit time after that is 1–3 days to the West Coast, 3–4 days to the Central U.S., 4–5 days to the Midwest, and 5–7 days to the East Coast. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
You’ll receive a tracking email when your order is ready to go. Our Shipping & Delivery page has the latest timeframes.
